description: Election Commission - Declare that I. A. M. R. Ilangakoon was Selected as the member of the Puttalam Pradeshiya Sabha Dectare that L. B. Kumara was Selected as the member of the Dehiaththakandiya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the filling of vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of selected members to fill seats that became vacant due to party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral procedures and declarations rather than government personnel appointments or structural changes.
